ev.q: CDC analyzed interim data from 33 outbreak-affected states to characterize demographic, risk factor, and clinical outcome data from 37,553 outbreak-associated hepatitis A cases
The number with available information was used as the denominator for percent calculations for each characteristic.
Among cases with available information, 56% of persons reported drug use, 14% reported homelessness, and 61% were hospitalized
Cumulative outbreak-associated hepatitis A cases reported, by state
Among persons with outbreak-associated HAV infection and available risk factor information, 56% reported injection or noninjection drug use

Sixty-one percent of persons were hospitalized during the hepatitis A outbreaks associated with person-to-person transmission, which substantially exceeds the proportion of hospitalized cases historically reported
Health departments investigated HAV infections among persons who met the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists’ hepatitis A case definition

methods_quotes.q: Risk factors were assessed during the exposure period (15–50 days before symptom onset).
States were excluded from variable-specific analysis of any variable with 100% missing data.
The number with available information was used as the denominator for percent calculations for each characteristic.
The analysis was conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
